title: Kool and the Gang
scene: Jersey City / New York early jazz-funk and R&B
notes: Jazz-rooted instrumental funk with brass arrangements, earthy basslines and lively ensemble interplay.

title: Music Is the Message
notes: Funk workouts alternate party vocals and extended solos; ARP leads the two-part Electric Frog.

title: Good Times
scene: New York exploratory funk with jazz and orchestral detours
notes: Hard funk and orchestral colours mingle with an explicit Coltrane homage and ARP textures.

title: Wild and Peaceful
scene: Jersey City / New York horn-driven party funk
notes: Breakthrough horn-driven funk: Jungle Boogie, Funky Stuff and Hollywood Swinging alongside calmer passages.

title: Light of Worlds
scene: New Jersey and New York jazz-funk, soulful instrumentals
notes: Intricate jazz-funk and spiritual themes, with luminous ARP and Mellotron textures on Summer Madness.

title: Spirit of the Boogie
scene: New York funk and jazz-funk with early disco crossover
notes: Thick bass grooves and group chants offset expansive jazz-funk, reflective passages and Caribbean rhythms.

title: Love & Understanding
scene: Mid-1970s New York funk, partly recorded live in London
notes: Five studio tracks and three London concert cuts; prominent horns and communal funk.

title: Open Sesame
scene: Philadelphia studio funk and disco crossover
notes: Funk-driven disco crossover, stronger female leads, brass refrains and carefully arranged ballads.

title: The Force
scene: New Jersey/Philadelphia funk with soul, horns and early disco
notes: Dense funk and brass jams, female vocals and strings alongside Minimoog and ARP textures.

title: Everybody's Dancin'
scene: Late-1970s Philadelphia/New York orchestrated funk-to-disco crossover
notes: Disco-oriented group funk with elaborate horns, strings, Rhodes piano and Cynthia Huggins vocals.

title: Ladies' Night
scene: New Jersey/New York crossover disco and melodic R&B
notes: J.T. Taylor introduces direct pop hooks over disciplined disco grooves and softer R&B ballads.

title: Celebrate!
scene: Early-1980s New Jersey dance-pop and disco-soul crossover
notes: Celebration dominates a polished disco-funk and pop-soul set, recorded as layered band tracks.
